dict.string: Orbit Desktop analyses the system audio output (levels and frequency bands only, nothing is recorded or sent anywhere) so the wallpaper can react to your music.
Orbit Desktop shows the coming week of events in the schedule widget. Events never leave this Mac.
Orbit Desktop asks Music or Spotify for the current track so the now-playing widget can show it, and pauses them during a strong Earthquake Early Warning (if enabled).
Orbit Desktop can place the night sky and weather at your current location (only if you enable it in layout.yaml).
